description: Create or update a single file in a GitHub repository.

branch.description: The branch to create or update the file on.

content.description: The new content of the file.

message.description: The commit message for the file creation or update.

owner.description: The owner of the repository containing the file.

path.description: The path to the file in the repository.

repo.description: The name of the repository containing the file.

sha.description: The blob SHA of the file being replaced, required when updating an existing file.
